responsibility: This header declares the public interface for non-function assembly emission and symbol/section management. It exposes APIs for creating RTL for declarations, one-only/COMDAT handling, section resolution, reference marking, assembler-name control, external processing, weak/alias emission, TLS/default-binding queries, validation of static initializer constants, initialization of varasm state, static space and trampoline assembly, and switching to COMDAT sections.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public API for the varasm stem, exposing routines for declaration RTL creation, weak/alias handling, section resolution, initializer validation, and COMDAT support. Unlike gcc/varasm.cc, it does not implement assembler output or maintain section state.
